sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Small Business - Part 1 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Hello. I have an errand for you. One of our people decided he could use my distribution lines on his own. It looks like our "entrepreneur" is marketing to cultists with souvenir figurines. Find them and bring them back, and I'll examine their insides."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:

- Hand over the item to Fence
- Find a Politician Mutkevich figurine in raid

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +22,800 EXP
- Fence Rep +0.02
- 1,800 Euros
  - 1,890 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 2,070 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 3× Virtex programmable processor
"Thanks. My suspicions have been confirmed. I hope you understand this job is not to be talked about."
